findings.description: False positive: Hardcoded Google Cloud OAuth scope in auto-generated protobuf file.
findings.reasoning: The code contains a hardcoded string that is a public Google Cloud OAuth scope (`https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform`). This is not a credential or a secret. It's a publicly known identifier used to request authorization. The scanner incorrectly flagged this as a hardcoded credential.
